issue.title: bob task merge into a requirement-owning task files copied notes outside the Notes drawer, leaving tidy debt

task_type_fields.impact: Every merge into a requirement-owning task leaves tidy debt (a layout-contract violation) that only an explicit `bob task tidy` repairs; reconcile never tidies, so the misfiled note stays until then.
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by bob-cli-q4.13 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1), triaged by the bob-cli-q4 land agent.

Root cause: `task_container` in `src/native/task_merge/containers.rs` picks the insertion offset as `capture::first_direct_managed_log_start(..)` or the destination's `block_end`. It never consults the requirement-aware note slot from `task_block_layout` (the Notes drawer end on a requirement-owning task; see docs/task-requirements.md and the q4.12 note_home layout vectors in tests/fixtures/task_reqs/layout.json). So `bob task merge SRC DEST` (without `-D`) into a destination that owns requirements files the copied content as loose task-level notes after the reqs, and a follow-up `bob task tidy --dry-run` plans a NOTES-filing move for that task.

Repro: in a temp vault, create an area note whose `## Tasks` has a destination task with one requirement child (`- [ ] req`), plus a source task with a note child. Run `bob task merge <src> <dest>` without `-D`, then `bob task tidy --dry-run -f json`: tidy plans one move filing the merged note into the destination's Notes drawer. The bob-cli-q4.13 acceptance suite (tests/cli/settle_acceptance.rs) only covers merge between requirement-less tasks for this reason.

Fix direction: route the task container's note insertion through the same requirement-aware note slot other writers use (task_block_layout note_home / ensure-Notes-drawer), or document `-D` as required for requirement-owning destinations. Add a CLI fixture asserting tidy plans nothing after merge into a requirement owner.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-q4.13 settle acceptance suite found merge leaves a tidy-planned NOTES-filing move when the destination owns requirements; the merge writer predates the epic and is not a settle concern, so it needs its own fix.

payload.description: The settle acceptance suite that found the merge tidy debt and covers only requirement-less merges
